results.title: TrussPoint Expands Midwest Footprint with Acquisition of Runyon & Sons Roofing
results.summary: TrussPoint Roofing & Exterior Renovations, backed by Soundcore Capital Partners, announced the acquisition of Runyon & Sons Roofing, a Northeast Ohio residential roofing company serving homeowners, multi-family, and commercial customers. The deal expands TrussPoint’s Midwest footprint and portfolio of regional brands (including Ridge Top Exteriors, Mario’s Roofing, Eaton Roofing & Exteriors, and Runyon & Sons). The acquisition emphasizes growth through add-on acquisitions in the residential roofing/exterior services space, maintaining Runyon & Sons’ local identity while providing enhanced resources and support for continued expansion. Key quotes highlight alignment of customer-first culture and growth ambitions.

results.title: Osceola-backed Valor Exterior Partners Announces Acquisition of Massachusetts-based Associate Roofing - Osceola Capital Management
results.summary:
Valor Exterior Partners (backed by Osceola Capital) announced the add-on acquisition of Associate Roofing, a southern Massachusetts-based exterior services provider. Key points:

- Acquisition expands Valor’s geographic reach into southern Massachusetts and Martha’s Vineyard; marks Valor’s ninth acquisition since Sept 2024 launch.
- Associate Roofing, founded in 1932, serves southern Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and nearby coastal islands with roofing, siding, and other exterior services.
- Leadership comments emphasize fit with Valor’s high-end residential focus and cross-selling opportunities, including cedar roof and siding preservation via Valor’s Cedar Life division.
- Osceola Capital highlights strengthened platform cash flow, regional presence, and growth potential through add-ons and inorganic expansion.
- About the firms: Valor Exterior Partners specializes in exterior home services; Associate Roofing is a long-established exterior contractor; Osceola Capital targets lower-middle-market services with buy-and-build strategy.

Relevance to query: Direct example of a 2026 private-equity add-on acquisition in the residential roofing/exterior services space.

results.title: Results Roofing, a TZP Group Portfolio Company, Acquires Journey Builders, Expanding Its Residential Re-Roofing Platform Across California and Texas | TZP Group
results.summary: TZP Group’s Results Roofing, a Dallas-based residential re-roofing platform, announced the acquisition of Journey Builders, a California/Texas residential re-roofing provider. The deal expands Results Roofing’s geographic footprint and capabilities, combining Journey Builders’ direct-to-homeowner retail model with Results Roofing’s insurance-driven re-roofing expertise and in-house claims management. Journey Builders, headquartered in Los Angeles and founded in 2022, handles about 2,000 projects per year and will operate under the Results Roofing brand. The transaction enhances cross-market reach across California and Texas and broadens lead generation and service offerings for both retail and insurance-driven customers. No financial terms were disclosed.

results.title: Awani Capital Management Announces the Recapitalization of Two Residential Roofing Companies to Form a Leading Retail-Focused Platform
results.summary: Awani Capital Management announces the recapitalization of two residential roofing firms, NewHaus Construction (Burbank, CA) and Universal Roofing & Construction (Glendale, CA), to form a leading retail-focused residential roofing platform serving California and Texas. The deal pairs Awani with management to accelerate growth, with NewHaus and Universal continuing as the platform’s core, cash-pay, retail roofing providers (approx. 90% roofing, 10% ancillary services). Awani will chair the board, Daphne Dufresne (Awani) join the board, and the partners aim to expand the national retail cash-pay roofing platform and pursue additional add-on acquisitions in the sector. Financial terms were not disclosed.

results.title: Royalty Roofing USA acquires Tingley Roofing, its fourth acquisition of 2026
results.summary: Royalty Roofing USA (backed by Six Pillars Partners) announces its fourth 2026 acquisition: Tingley Roofing, a Paris, Illinois-based residential and commercial contractor. Tingley joins Royalty’s portfolio with brand retention kept, continuing to operate under its name. The deal tightens Royalty’s Midwest footprint near its Seymour, Indiana base and follows a rapid add-on strategy this year, including acquisitions in Michigan, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Vermont/New Hampshire, and now Illinois. The platform emphasizes keeping acquired brands to preserve reputation and culture. Terms were not disclosed.
